"""Underline all headlines in quarterly_report.docx (unpacked intermediate).

Headline identification: paragraphs whose text is non-empty, contains at least
one alphabetic character, and contains no lowercase characters (i.e. the
all-caps section-title lines such as "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY", "RISK FACTORS").
Body sentences contain lowercase and are excluded; bullet/table rows contain
lowercase and are excluded; the box-drawing separator line has no letters and
is excluded.
"""
import xml.dom.minidom as minidom

DOC = 'unpacked/word/document.xml'
NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'

with open(DOC, 'r', encoding='ascii') as fh:
    raw = fh.read()
first_nl = raw.index('\n')
decl = raw[:first_nl]

dom = minidom.parse(DOC)
doc_el = dom.documentElement


def para_text(p):
    parts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(NS, 't'):
        if t.firstChild is not None:
            parts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    return ''.join(parts)


def is_headline(text):
    s = text.strip()
    if not s:
        return False
    if not any(ch.isalpha() for ch in s):
        return False
    return not any(ch.islower() for ch in s)


def set_underline(rpr):
    # Remove any existing <w:u> in this rPr first (idempotency).
    for child in list(rpr.childNodes):
        if child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE and child.localName == 'u':
            rpr.removeChild(child)
    # Append <w:u w:val="single"/> after sz/sz-cs: valid rPr child order
    # (rFonts, sz, szCs, highlight, u, ...). These run properties contain only
    # rFonts/sz/sz-cs, so appending at the end is schema-correct.
    u = dom.createElementNS(NS, 'w:u')
    u.setAttribute('w:val', 'single')
    rpr.appendChild(u)


headline_count = 0
run_count = 0
for p in doc_el.getElementsByTagNameNS(NS, 'p'):
    if not is_headline(para_text(p)):
        continue
    headline_count += 1
    for r in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(NS, 'r'):
        for rpr in r.getElementsByTagNameNS(NS, 'rPr'):
            set_underline(rpr)
            run_count += 1

print('headline paragraphs found:', headline_count)
print('runs underlined:', run_count)


class Writer(object):
    def __init__(self):
        self.parts = []

    def write(self, s):
        self.parts.append(s)


w = Writer()
doc_el.writexml(w)
out = decl + '\n' + ''.join(w.parts) + '\n'
data = out.encode('ascii', 'xmlcharrefreplace')
with open(DOC, 'wb') as fh:
    fh.write(data)
print('document.xml written')

"""Underline all headline (all-caps section title) paragraphs in the unpacked
quarterly_report.docx intermediate artifact (unpacked_quarterly_report/)."""

from pathlib import Path

import defusedxml.minidom as minidom

DOC_PATH = Path("unpacked_quarterly_report/word/document.xml")
W_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"


def collect_text(element):
    """Concatenate text of all descendant w:t nodes."""
    parts = []
    for t in element.getElementsByTagNameNS(W_NS, "t"):
        if t.firstChild is not None:
            parts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue)
    return "".join(parts)


def is_headline(text):
    stripped = text.strip()
    if len(stripped) < 2:
        return False
    if stripped[0] == "\u2022":  # bullet-point rows are not headlines
        return False
    if not any(c.isalpha() for c in stripped):  # dash separator line, etc.
        return False
    if any(c.islower() for c in stripped):  # body text has lowercase
        return False
    return True


def underline_run(run, dom):
    rpr = None
    for child in run.childNodes:
        if (
            child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE
            and child.namespaceURI == W_NS
            and child.localName == "rPr"
        ):
            rpr = child
            break
    if rpr is None:
        rpr = dom.createElementNS(W_NS, "w:rPr")
        run.insertBefore(rpr, run.firstChild)
    # Drop any pre-existing underline property, then apply single underline.
    for u in [
        c
        for c in rpr.childNodes
        if c.nodeType == c.ELEMENT_NODE and c.namespaceURI == W_NS and c.localName == "u"
    ]:
        rpr.removeChild(u)
    u = dom.createElementNS(W_NS, "w:u")
    u.setAttributeNS(W_NS, "w:val", "single")
    rpr.appendChild(u)


dom = minidom.parse(str(DOC_PATH))
headlines = []

for paragraph in dom.getElementsByTagNameNS(W_NS, "p"):
    text = collect_text(paragraph)
    if not is_headline(text):
        continue
    runs = [
        r
        for r in paragraph.getElementsByTagNameNS(W_NS, "r")
        if r.parentNode is paragraph
    ]
    for run in runs:
        underline_run(run, dom)
    headlines.append(text.strip())

with open(DOC_PATH, "w", encoding="ascii") as fh:
    fh.write(dom.toprettyxml(indent="  ", encoding="ascii").decode("ascii"))

print(f"Underlined {len(headlines)} headline paragraph(s):")
for title in headlines:
    print(f"  - {title}")

Headline identification: paragraphs whose text is non-empty, contains at least
one alphabetic character, and contains no lowercase characters (i.e. the

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'

first_nl = raw.index('\n')
decl = raw[:first_nl]

def para_text(p):
    parts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(NS, 't'):

def is_headline(text):
    s = text.strip()
    if not s:
        return False
    if not any(ch.isalpha() for ch in s):
        return False
    return not any(ch.islower() for ch in s)

    # Remove any existing <w:u> in this rPr first (idempotency).
    for child in list(rpr.childNodes):

W_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"


def collect_text(element):
    """Concatenate text of all descendant w:t nodes."""
    parts = []
    for t in element.getElementsByTagNameNS(W_NS, "t"):
        if t.firstChild is not None:
            parts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue)
    return "".join(parts)


def is_headline(text):
    stripped = text.strip()
    if len(stripped) < 2:
        return False
    if stripped[0] == "\u2022":  # bullet-point rows are not headlines
        return False
    if not any(c.isalpha() for c in stripped):  # dash separator line, etc.
        return False
    if any(c.islower() for c in stripped):  # body text has lowercase
        return False
    return True


def underline_run(run, dom):
    rpr = None
    for child in run.childNodes:
        if (
            child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE
            and child.namespaceURI == W_NS
            and child.localName == "rPr"
        ):
            rpr = child
            break
    if rpr is None:
        rpr = dom.createElementNS(W_NS, "w:rPr")
        run.insertBefore(rpr, run.firstChild)
    # Drop any pre-existing underline property, then apply single underline.
    for u in [
        c
        for c in rpr.childNodes
        if c.nodeType == c.ELEMENT_NODE and c.namespaceURI == W_NS and c.localName == "u"
    ]:
        rpr.removeChild(u)
    u = dom.createElementNS(W_NS, "w:u")
    u.setAttributeNS(W_NS, "w:val", "single")
    rpr.appendChild(u)

    runs = [
        r
        for r in paragraph.getElementsByTagNameNS(W_NS, "r")
        if r.parentNode is paragraph
    ]
    for run in runs:
        underline_run(run, dom)
    headlines.append(text.strip())

for title in headlines:
    print(f"  - {title}")
